channel.title: Bangladesh Capital & Money Markets — Daily Pulse
channel.description: AI-curated daily Good / Bad / Ugly assessment of developments in the Dhaka Stock Exchange and the broader Bangladesh money markets.

item.title: [UGLY] DSE Revokes Sonali Securities' Trading License
item.description:
Category: Ugly

Reason: The Dhaka Stock Exchange canceled the Trading Right Entitlement Certificate (TREC) of Sonali Securities Limited due to a violation of regulatory rules.

Recorded: 2026-05-11

item.title: [GOOD] DBH Recommends 15% Cash Dividend
item.description:
Category: Good

Reason: The company's board of directors proposed a 15% cash dividend for the fiscal year ending December 31, 2025, indicating a return to shareholders.

Recorded: 2026-05-11

item.title: [GOOD] BNICL Reports Strong Q1 Earnings Growth
item.description:
Category: Good

Reason: Bangladesh National Insurance Company Limited (BNICL) saw its Earnings Per Share (EPS) increase significantly from Tk. 1.06 to Tk. 1.61 in the first quarter of 2026.

Recorded: 2026-05-11

item.title: [BAD] Agrani Insurance Reports Significant Q1 Earnings Decline
item.description:
Category: Bad

Reason: Agrani Insurance Company Limited experienced a sharp drop in consolidated EPS from Tk. 0.33 to Tk. 0.17 in Q1 2026, primarily due to lower premium income and increased management expenses.

Recorded: 2026-05-11

item.title: [BAD] DBH Faces Significant Operating Cash Outflow in Q1
item.description:
Category: Bad

Reason: Despite an increase in EPS, DBH's Net Operating Cash Flow Per Share (NOCFPS) turned negative in Q1 2026 due to a substantial reversal in deposit funding, with repayments exceeding new deposits.

Recorded: 2026-05-11

item.title: [BAD] IPDC Experiences Sharp Decline in Q1 Operating Cash Flow
item.description:
Category: Bad

Reason: IPDC's Net Operating Cash Flow Per Share (NOCFPS) significantly decreased in Q1 2026, primarily due to a substantial reduction in customer deposit inflows compared to the previous year.

Recorded: 2026-05-11

item.title: [GOOD] Saiham Textile Mills to Modernize Spinning Unit for Enhanced Capacity
item.description:
Category: Good

Reason: Saiham Textile Mills will temporarily suspend its old spinning unit for Balancing, Modernization, Rehabilitation, and Expansion (BMRE) to install new machinery, aiming for significantly increased production capacity and profitability.
